item.title: BJP launches mega nationwide outreach to promote Union Budget 2026 with 150 press meets, podcasts
item.description: The BJP has announced a large-scale nationwide outreach plan to promote the Union Budget 2026, involving 150 press conferences, influencer collaborations, podcasts, and public discussions. The party will engage multiple social groups and publish opinion pieces by top leaders.

item.title: Cervical cancer symptoms you shouldn’t ignore: Pain after intercourse explained
item.description: Pain after intercourse may seem normal, but it can be an early warning sign of cervical cancer. Learn why this symptom should not be ignored, its causes, and when to see a doctor.

item.title: 'Mere haathon yeh mar gayi hai': Husband's call to SWAT commando Kajal's brother after fatal beating
item.description: Delhi: Married on Nov 23, 2023, Kajal endured constant abuse from day one driven by dowry demands, as her mother disclosed. Ankur's parents and siblings relentlessly pressured for more, with conflicts intensifying after the wedding.

item.title: Bridgerton Season 4: Anthony and Kate's first visuals from part 2 excites fans | See reactions
item.description: Bridgerton season 4 part 1 has several mentions of Anthony and Kate, but the two were nowhere to be seen. But the makers were quick to compensate for their absence as they shared the teaser of the second part.

item.title: UP Police Constable Recruitment 2026: Last date to apply today for 32,679 posts at uppbpb.gov.in
item.description: UP Police Constable Recruitment Registration 2026: The candidates can apply for UP Police Constable posts on the official website- uppbpb.gov.in. The UP Police Constable Recruitment 2026 drive is being held for 32,679 police constable posts.

item.title: BGMI redeem codes for januar 30: KRAFTON India drops Frilly Ribbon Backpack and more
item.description: KRAFTON India has released a fresh batch of BGMI redeem codes on January 30, allowing players to unlock exclusive in-game rewards such as the Frilly Ribbon Backpack. The codes are valid until February 28, 2026, and can be redeemed through BGMI’s official website on a first-come, first-served basis.

item.title: Building collapses in Delhi's Preet Vihar, firefighters rush to spot, rescue operation underway
item.description: Building collapses in Delhi’s Preet Vihar: Upon arrival, firefighters found that the false ceiling of the old Water Board office had collapsed; further investigation is underway. As of now, nothing serious has been reported.

item.title: IT stocks surges 12% even as stock market tank in early trade after 3-day rally, check details
item.description: The stock has been gaining for the last three days and has risen 11.57 per cent in the period. However, the stock has been highly volatile today with an intraday volatility of 7.35 per cent.

item.title: Tamil Nadu: Massive gas cylinder blast in Karaikudi injures three during cooking mishap
item.description: Tamil Nadu: Karaikudi Fire and Rescue Department arrived promptly at the site, quickly dousing the blaze and cordoning off the area for safety. The three seriously injured victims received immediate transport to a local hospital for urgent care, where their conditions were initially stabilised.

item.title: CUET UG registration 2026 to close at cuet.nta.nic.in today; details here
item.description: CUET UG registration 2026: CUET UG 2026 is scheduled to be held between May 11 and 31. The last date to apply for CUET UG 2026 is today, January 30. Apply for CUET UG on the official website- cuet.nta.nic.in.
